description: Create a new Antenatal Record 1 (AR1) for patient Diana Prince. Log in to OSCAR EMR (username: oscardoc, password: oscar, PIN: 1117). Locate Diana Prince's chart and navigate to the Antenatal forms section. Initialize a new Antenatal Record 1. Enter the Last Menstrual Period (LMP) date as exactly 8 weeks ago from today. Ensure the Estimated Date of Delivery (EDD) is calculated, then save the form.
